purpose: Convert compact cache implementation reason codes into canonical decision-ledger reason codes and prove a final non-ambiguous price-blind taste state for every current candidate.

mapping_rationale.include_codes: Implementation detail only; canonical ledger requires a valid fit level for INCLUDE and does not require an exclusion reason.
mapping_rationale.exclude_insufficient: The candidate failed to establish moderate fit, which is canonically below_moderate_fit.
mapping_rationale.exclude_audited_below: The targeted audit used the same threshold and left the candidate below moderate fit, so the canonical final reason is below_moderate_fit.
mapping_rationale.exclude_direct_conflict: The conflict is the evidence explaining why the candidate remains below the minimum moderate threshold. below_moderate_fit is a canonical valid final exclusion code for both direct and structural conflicts; this mapping does not claim direct_strong_negative_user_evidence when that stronger evidence type is not uniformly true for every entry carrying the implementation code.

must: reject verdict/fit-level combinations inconsistent with the implementation mapping
for every EXCLUDE map to a reason code currently present in canonical valid_exclusion_reason_codes
for every INCLUDE require a non-empty fit level
prove INCLUDE plus EXCLUDE equals processed
prove no ambiguous or borderline final state remains
bind the result to exact policy, mapping, taste-index and full-fingerprint-validation input blobs

accept_only_if_all: policy_blob_sha equals stage 01 canonical policy SHA
taste_index_blob_sha equals stage 04 current compact taste-index SHA
taste_validation_blob_sha equals the exact stage 07 validation artifact SHA
taste_validation reports complete coverage for the same 583 current candidates
